invariants.rationale: element is used to retrieve attributes and children, so it must not be null.
getRelativeFileHandle and possibly other file operations require tmxFile to be non-null.
imageResolver is passed to addStaticTiles, so a null value would likely cause an error.
element.getName() is dereferenced and tested for equals, so it should be non-null.
element may have any number of children but cannot have negative.
